player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {num_rounds}-round a IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kwa round biara, susuw biribi kati {min_guess} ne {max_guess}.
Akyiri guesses abien no, target no yɛ (2/3)x(asɛm a wɔbɔɔ guesses abien no),
na player a ne guess yɛ kɔɔ target no na ɔdi round no.
Kɔm bɔ wo guess wɔ format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format no nyɛ papa; fa wo nkyerԑkyerԑmu to hɔ sԑ [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Guess noa ni bɛn {min_guess} ne {max_guess} ntam.

message.round_guesses: ɔkɔtɔni 0 ka bomaa {guess0}; ɔkɔtɔni 1 ka bomaa {guess1}. Enti Target no ne: {target}.
message.round_win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {winner} na ɔdi nkonim wɔ ɔfã no mu!

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin 1 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.draw: Ne nyinaa mu no, agoru yi yɛ nea wɔmmɔ.
